# Lab 12.9: Anomaly Detection: PCA & Autoencoder

## What We Are Going to Do
Train PCA and autoencoder models on order data and use `ML.DETECT_ANOMALIES` to flag unusual orders.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Build numeric features per order.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab12.order_features AS
SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(*) AS items,
  SUM(sale_price) AS total,
  MAX(sale_price) AS max_item,
  COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`
GROUP BY order_id;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] PCA model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.orders_pca
OPTIONS (model_type = 'PCA', num_principal_components = 2, scale_features = TRUE)
AS SELECT items, total, max_item, distinct_products FROM lab12.order_features;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Autoencoder model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.orders_ae
OPTIONS (model_type = 'AUTOENCODER', activation_fn = 'RELU', hidden_units = [8, 2, 8], max_iterations = 15)
AS SELECT items, total, max_item, distinct_products FROM lab12.order_features;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Detect anomalies (top 1%).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT order_id, items, total, is_anomaly, mean_squared_error
FROM ML.DETECT_ANOMALIES(MODEL lab12.orders_ae, STRUCT(0.01 AS contamination),
  (SELECT * FROM lab12.order_features))
WHERE is_anomaly
ORDER BY mean_squared_error DESC
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Repeat with `MODEL lab12.orders_pca` and compare which orders each model flags.

5. **[CLI] Count anomalies per model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for M in orders_pca orders_ae; do
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "SELECT '$M' m, COUNTIF(is_anomaly) n FROM ML.DETECT_ANOMALIES(MODEL lab12.$M, STRUCT(0.01 AS contamination), (SELECT * FROM lab12.order_features))"
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `contamination` | Expected share of anomalies (1%) |
| Score | Reconstruction error |
| Flagged orders | Very large or unusual baskets |
| Also possible | K-means and ARIMA_PLUS for anomalies |
